professionalSummary.pt: Desenvolvedor Full-Stack com foco em Back-End e mais de 3 anos de desenvolvimento com TypeScript, NestJS, Node.js, React e Python, construindo plataformas SaaS, produtos de comunicação com IA, microserviços orientados a eventos, sistemas em tempo real e integrações de API. Fundador e único engenheiro da TheChats.me (SaaS de mensagens/CRM com IA) e Web Developer em meio período na Angry Ventures. Evoluiu do suporte técnico, com Linux, SSH, logs, VoIP e Asterisk, para arquitetura de backend, refatoração de legado e produtos SaaS multi-tenant. Mestrando em Engenharia Informática na Universidade do Algarve.
professionalSummary.en: Backend-focused Full-Stack Software Engineer with 3+ years of software development in TypeScript, NestJS, Node.js, React and Python, building SaaS platforms, AI-powered communication products, event-driven microservices, real-time systems and API integrations. Founder and sole engineer of TheChats.me (AI-assisted messaging/CRM SaaS) and part-time Web Developer at Angry Ventures. Started in technical support with Linux, SSH, logs, VoIP and Asterisk, then moved into backend architecture, legacy refactoring and multi-tenant SaaS development. MSc student in Informatics Engineering at the University of Algarve.

experience.title: Founder & Software Engineer
responsibilities: Founder and sole engineer of an AI-assisted customer messaging platform (website live chat, shared inbox and CRM) that includes DropHub, a multichannel e-commerce module; designing, building and running the product end to end

Built a multi-tenant microservices backend with Node.js, TypeScript and NestJS 11 on PostgreSQL (Drizzle ORM), Redis and RabbitMQ: ~50 modules, role-based access, plan-based feature gating and a 96-endpoint Admin API documented in OpenAPI/Swagger

Developed the React 19/Vite dashboard (36+ modules, Zustand, TanStack Query, visual workflow/chatbot builder), an embeddable WebChat widget and an Astro marketing site and blog deployed on Cloudflare Workers
Built a real-time inbox over WebSockets (Socket.IO) with ticket workflows, SLA rules, CSAT surveys and analytics

Built the Python AI engine: RabbitMQ workers, multi-provider LLM agents (OpenAI, Anthropic, Together AI and self-hosted Ollama), an MCP server, RAG knowledge-base answers, ticket insights and lead scoring

Integrated Meta APIs (WhatsApp Cloud API, Instagram, Messenger) with OAuth and webhooks, Stripe billing and marketplace APIs (eBay, Etsy, WooCommerce, Vinted, Shopify) for DropHub, plus a Chrome MV3 extension

Run the infrastructure with Docker on Linux VPS servers, a WireGuard VPN, GitHub Actions CI/CD with self-hosted runners, GHCR and automated offsite backups; test suites with Jest, Vitest, Cypress and Pytest
